reason: Real local GTM payload validation, snippet generation and heuristic audit are implemented; no GTM management API, snippet escaping defects and misleading GA4 send success handling warrant review.
exposure: All four tools registered unconditionally; no configuration or read-only groups. GA4 transmission is a separate product tool. Audit also supports Meta CAPI and GA4; snippet also supports GA4 and React.
limitations: Offline tools/list obtained from isolated source copy with freshly resolved semver dependencies, not a pinned upstream lockfile: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and zod versions are preserved in work package-lock.json. No tool operations executed.
Audit readiness score is an implementation heuristic, not GA4 validation or actual Meta EMQ.
GA4 sender falls back to demo credentials and masks fetch failures as simulated_success; HTTP error responses are not treated as errors.
Snippet generation does not escape event names or object property keys. Validator schema prevents reporting several invalid types because MCP rejects them first.

tools.name: validate_datalayer_event
tools.description: Validates a GTM DataLayer event payload against GA4 & E-commerce schema standards to detect missing parameters or invalid types.

event.description: The name of the DataLayer event (e.g. 'purchase', 'add_to_cart', 'lead')

value.description: Monetary value associated with the event

transaction_id.description: Unique transaction ID for purchase events

user_data.description: Hashed user data for CAPI matching

eventPayload.description: The complete DataLayer event JSON object to validate

tools.behavior: Locally checks event presence, selected ecommerce fields and purchase transaction_id; MCP schema requires both item_id and item_name plus price and quantity before handler validation (controller.ts L6-L109).

tools.name: send_ga4_measurement_protocol_event
tools.description: Transmits a server-side analytics event to Google Analytics 4 via Measurement Protocol API.

eventName.description: Name of the event to track (e.g. 'purchase', 'page_view')

measurementId.description: GA4 Measurement ID override (default read from ENV)

apiSecret.description: GA4 API Secret override (default read from ENV)

tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4: posts to /mp/collect using argument or environment credentials, with demo fallback credentials; network failures return simulated_success and any non-204 response is reported as submitted (controller.ts L114-L159).

tools.name: generate_tracking_code_snippet
tools.description: Generates production-ready tracking code snippets for GTM dataLayer.push, GA4 gtag.js, or React custom hook.

platform.description: Target platform format for code generation

tools.behavior: Locally generates dataLayer.push, gtag or React hook text without installing it; event names and property keys are interpolated without escaping, so arbitrary inputs can generate invalid JavaScript (controller.ts L164-L199).

tools.name: audit_tracking_readiness
tools.description: Audits a tracking event payload against GA4 or Meta CAPI readiness standards and returns an EMQ/Quality score (0-100) with actionable recommendations.
tools.behavior: Locally assigns a heuristic score from missing event, ecommerce or Meta user_data fields; GA4 and GTM share checks and the Meta score is not a measured EMQ (controller.ts L204-L260).

review.summary: Check dataLayer event fields, generate GTM/gtag snippets, and score supplied tracking payloads with local heuristics.
